title: Plasma compression fusion device paper cited in China and IEEE Cybernetics

tellings.quote: no however there's a paper out there plasma compression fusion device you and I were talking right before uh it's being cited by some very important and uh research teams in China and the latest that's being start cited is of this year I e journal cybernetics

plain: Salvatore Pais, a Navy scientist who holds patents on unusual craft designs, says his paper on a plasma compression fusion device is being cited "by some very important" research teams in China, and that the latest to cite it, this year, is an IEEE journal on cybernetics (IEEE is the professional body of electrical engineers). Pais tells Michels this about his own work, as a sign that his ideas are being taken seriously abroad.
